provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium lancifolium, plant_name_id 279922.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1916), Lilium tigrinum, p. 1870 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-18): stem stout, 2-4 ft high, var. splendens often 6-7 ft; FNA: stems to 2 m. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.9 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1916), Lilium tigrinum, p. 1870 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-18): stem stout, 2-4 ft high, var. splendens often 6-7 ft; FNA: stems to 2 m.

traits.bark_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems white-lanate, purplish; Bailey: deep purplish brown, covered with white or greyish cobweb-like down. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves scattered

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 10-15(-18) x ca. 1.5 cm

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves ca. 1.5 cm wide, ca. 3-6(-10) times longer than wide

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade lanceolate, often narrowly so

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves horizontal and drooping at tips

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences racemose, 3-6(-25)-flowered

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers pendent, not fragrant

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth Turk's-cap-shaped; sepals and petals reflexed ca. 1/5-1/4 along length from base

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): reflexed ca. 1/5-1/4 along length from base

traits.bulbils.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): distal leaves bearing 1(-3) dark purple axillary bulbils. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.bulbil_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): dark purple axillary bulbils The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): orange; Bailey (p. 1870): bright salmon-red segments The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): orange with many purple-brown spots

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): purple-brown spots; Bailey: spotted purplish black The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals and petals 7-10 x 1-2 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens strongly exserted

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers purplish, ca. 2 cm; pollen rust The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel sometimes dichotomous, stout and relatively short, to 10 cm. The least and typical lengths are our reading of 'relatively short'

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 3-4 cm

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium lancifolium (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering late summer (mid Jul-early Sep); Bailey: Aug, Sept
